Description: New HIV infection through sexual contact with infected individuals; transmission probability varies by phase (acute, chronic, final)
Birth/recruitment into susceptible population at birth rate
Background mortality of susceptible individuals
Testing and initiation of antiretroviral therapy after screening
Death from HIV disease progression (Weibull survival) and background mortality
Drop-out from ART or treatment failure
Death from disease progression on treatment and background mortality

Name: β
Description: Initial transmission parameter

Name: λ (location)
Description: Transmission parameter location (shape of transmission curve)

Name: n (shape)
Description: Transmission parameter shape

Name: ε (relative transmission on ART)
Description: Relative transmissibility of individuals on ART compared to untreated

Name: Birth rate μ
Description: Birth/recruitment rate into the population

Name: Background mortality rate δ
Description: Background (non-HIV) mortality rate

Name: Progression rate untreated φ
Description: Disease progression rate for untreated individuals

Name: Progression rate treated γ
Description: Disease progression rate for individuals on ART

Name: Intervention timing t
Description: Year when intervention (universal testing and ART) begins

Name: Intervention rate r
Description: Rate of roll-out of the intervention

Name: Intervention maximum m
Description: Maximum coverage of the intervention

Name: Testing rate σ
Description: Rate of HIV testing

Name: Testing refusal θ
Description: Proportion refusing HIV testing

Name: Drop-out rate ω
Description: Rate of dropping out of ART

Name: Treatment failure rate κ
Description: Rate of virological treatment failure on ART

Name: Other interventions reduction ψ
Description: Reduction in transmission from other interventions (e.g. condoms, circumcision)

Name: Survival median
Description: Median survival time without treatment (Weibull distribution)

Name: Survival shape
Description: Shape parameter of Weibull survival distribution

Name: Acute phase duration
Description: Duration of the acute phase of HIV infection

Name: Acute phase infectivity
Description: Infectivity during the acute phase

Name: Chronic phase infectivity
Description: Infectivity during the chronic phase

Name: Final phase infectivity
Description: Infectivity during the final phase

Name: Final phase duration
Description: Duration of the final phase as a proportion of expected survival

Name: Concurrency number
Description: Number of concurrent sexual partners

Name: Partnership duration
Description: Mean duration of a sexual partnership

Name: Initial CD4 mu
Description: Location parameter for initial CD4 count distribution

Name: Initial CD4 sigma
Description: Shape parameter for initial CD4 count distribution
